method.freshness: The current generated render batch is the set of PNGs newer than collection-audit-06.json. This avoids using older legacy filenames as current visual evidence.
technical: Verified current authoring-to-technical master hashes, v2 manifests, manifest asset bytes/SHA checks, parsed GLB declarations, dimensions, source IDs and fidelity labels.
Parsed all 84 current GLBs and compared declared and parsed triangles, materials, textures and images, including exterior and interior LOD pairs.
Compared the current render batch with metrics, scene reports and draft quality screenshot records without modifying any of those records.
visual: Inspected all 391 current-batch renders: 161 exterior, 111 room, 59 deck and 60 exploded frames.
Reviewed collection-scale current-batch contact sheets and targeted current frames for Princess V55, Superhawk, Predator 57 and Manhattan 63.
Computed normalized mean luminance on every current-batch frame; room, deck and exploded batches were checked separately for unusable darkness.
method.independence: No draft quality record is accepted as independent approval. All 20 remain independent-qa-pending and changes-required.

collectionBlockers.title: Current render batch is not fully indexed by review metadata
collectionBlockers.finding: The current post-audit-06 batch contains 391 renders and is fully represented in scene reports, but only 42 current paths appear in metrics files. Draft quality records contain 370 screenshot records, but only 130 reference current-batch paths; 240 still reference older legacy renders. Only V55 and Superhawk quality records match current manifest/master hashes (2/20). The referenced-file hashes pass, but that does not certify the new renders.
collectionBlockers.requiredAction: Regenerate metrics and quality records from the current batch, replace legacy paths, recompute manifest/master/screenshot hashes, and rerun QA without changing production assets during the audit.

collectionBlockers.title: Reference-faithful geometry remains unproven
collectionBlockers.finding: The current manifests preserve varied primitives: 268 boxes, 48 cylinders, 78 decks, 44 chamfered boxes and 21 hull components. The visual fleet is still a simplified repeated hull/superstructure vocabulary, and the current quality records fail distinctive-features for all 20. Primitive diversity alone does not establish model-specific reference fidelity.
collectionBlockers.requiredAction: Refine each hull, glazing, roofline, deck and model-specific feature against its reference dossier, then review the current batch after metadata is regenerated.

collectionBlockers.title: Rooms remain blockouts and V55 current rooms are blank
collectionBlockers.finding: All 111 current room files exist and the room-camera clipping seen in audit 06 is not confirmed in the new batch. The rooms are still mostly furniture/partition primitives without complete shells, joinery, fixtures, machinery or supported fittings. Princess V55 is worse: all 10 current room renders are uniform blue/empty frames, so its room evidence is unusable.
collectionBlockers.requiredAction: Complete the room assemblies and regenerate V55 room/deck renders with visible geometry; then verify support, intersection, seam and furnishing checks on the new paths.

collectionBlockers.title: Material payloads are present but visually insufficient
collectionBlockers.finding: All 84 GLBs contain texture/image payloads, but all 626 embedded images are 32x32 PNGs and the current renders remain largely flat color-block treatments. The synchronized draft records fail textures and materials-in-all-views on all 20.
collectionBlockers.requiredAction: Use sufficiently resolved, model-appropriate materials and demonstrate consistent, legible material treatment in every current canonical view.

collectionBlockers.title: Residual exterior evidence is still too dark
collectionBlockers.finding: The camera/lighting pass fixed the room and deck luminance gate in the current batch: all 111 room and 59 deck frames are above the 8% mean-luminance threshold, and no current room camera clipping is confirmed. Three exterior frames remain below threshold: Princess V55 below-hull and port-profile, plus Superhawk port-three-quarter.
collectionBlockers.requiredAction: Relight or reframe those three current exterior views and repeat the visual gate.

collectionBlockers.title: Interior LODs are unchanged
collectionBlockers.finding: Exterior LOD1 is lighter for 19/20 pairs, but Superhawk remains 13200 -> 13200 triangles. All 22 interior pairs retain the same triangle count; 16 are byte-identical and six differ in bytes without reducing triangles.
collectionBlockers.requiredAction: Produce genuinely lighter, visually acceptable interior LODs and a lighter Superhawk exterior LOD, then rerun parsed triangle checks.

collectionBlockers.title: No independent approval exists
collectionBlockers.finding: All 20 quality records remain changes-required with reviewer independent-qa-pending. All technical visual reviews remain pending, all publicationReady flags are false, and all metrics self-review statuses remain not QA-approved.
collectionBlockers.requiredAction: After the current-batch evidence and model blockers are fixed, run a new independent QA pass and record explicit approval per selected ID.

releaseDecision.reason: The new render pass improves room camera framing and lighting for the current batch, but the batch is not fully indexed by metrics/quality metadata, Princess V55 has blank current room/deck evidence, three current exterior frames remain too dark, room and exterior geometry remain coarse, interior LODs are unchanged, and no independent approval exists.
releaseDecision.nextGate: Regenerate metrics and quality records from the current batch, fix Princess V55 blank room/deck renders and the three dark exterior frames, complete model-specific rooms/materials/geometry, produce genuinely lighter interior LODs, and repeat independent QA.
